hypothesis: A cart with OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3 needs 12 WIDGET units but only 10 are stocked. Each line is validated against available stock alone (6<=10, 6<=10) and entries sharing the inventory item are not summed in ensureInventoryLevels, so the order completes and reserves 12 > 10, failing no_oversell.
submitted_scenario:
schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: per-line-shared-item
description: One cart has two lines sharing the WIDGET item that together need more than stock.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 1
stock:
  WIDGET: 10
carts:
  big:
    server: 1
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-PIECE
      qty: 6
    - sku: OVS-TWOPACK
      qty: 3
race:
- id: big-completes
  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: big
timing:
  release: together
faults: []
runs: 3
seed: 1
